description: This file defines an Android Service (`IsolatedService`) that uses remote callbacks to notify clients of value changes. It includes internal classes for controlling the service from an activity, handling binding, starting, stopping, and managing callbacks.

classes.name: IsolatedService
classes.description: An Android Service that uses remote callbacks to communicate with clients, demonstrating use of android:isolatedProcess.

classes.name: IsolatedService.Controller
classes.description: An activity class to control the lifecycle and binding of `IsolatedService`, managing start, stop, bind, and unbind operations.

classes.name: ServiceInfo
classes.description: Inner class within Controller to encapsulate service control logic including binding, unbinding, and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Called when the service is created; logs creation.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Called when the service is destroyed; unregisters callbacks and logs destruction.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder interface for clients to interact with.

methods.name: broadcastValue
methods.description: Sends a value update notification to all registered callbacks.
